steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ Unit 1 — ask about someone’s life and week; talk about routines and what you like doing
✓ Unit 2 — describe what is normal and what is happening now; define a thing you can’t name; give directions
✓ Unit 3 — tell what happened, in sequence, and say what you were doing when it happened
✓ Unit 4 — talk about decisions and plans; invite someone and make an arrangement
✓ Unit 5 — describe objects and quantities; explain a word you don’t know; complain and ask for a refund
✓ Unit 6 — describe and compare people; talk about experiences; give and react to news
